title: DNA/RNA Extraction and Cleanup Protocol for Coral Samples
author: Carsten Grupstra
materials: Turn on required equipment: 4°C centrifuge and 42°C heat block/water bath. Sterilize working surfaces and equipment using a 10% bleach solution (remake weekly) for 20 minutes. Then, remove the bleach with a dry paper towel and clean benches and equipment with a 70% ethanol solution.

steps.title: Add digest buffer and proteinase K
steps.instruction: Add 600 µl DNA digest buffer and 6 µl proteinase K to a labeled 1.5 ml tube for each sample; keep tubes on ice.

steps.title: Collect and grind coral tissue
steps.instruction: Using sterilized forceps and razor blades, scrape coral tissue roughly the size of a large rice grain, grind to a fine dust in a sterile petri dish, and transfer the dust into the tube prepared in Step 1.

steps.title: Vortex samples
steps.instruction: Vortex all tubes for 1–2 minutes.

steps.title: Incubate with vortex
steps.instruction: Incubate tubes at 42 °C for 30 minutes, vortex briefly, then incubate for an additional ≥30 minutes at 42 °C.

steps.title: Prepare precipitation reagents
steps.instruction: While the incubation proceeds, label sterile 1.5 ml tubes and add 30 µl 3 M sodium acetate (NaOAc) and 750 µl 100 % ethanol to each.

steps.title: Vortex after incubation
steps.instruction: When incubation finishes, vortex all samples briefly.

steps.title: Add phenol‑chloroform‑isoamyl alcohol
steps.instruction: In the fume hood, add 600 µl phenol‑chloroform‑isoamyl alcohol (PCA) to each tube, using the lower layer; cap tightly (PCA is caustic).

steps.title: Mix PCA and chill
steps.instruction: Vortex tubes for several seconds in the fume hood until the mixture appears milky white; immediately return tubes to ice.

steps.title: Final vortex and chill
steps.instruction: Thoroughly vortex all tubes again, then place on ice for 1 minute.

steps.title: Centrifuge first spin
steps.instruction: Centrifuge tubes at maximum speed (≈32,000 × g) for 5 minutes at 4 °C; then keep tubes on ice.

steps.title: Collect aqueous phase
steps.instruction: In the fume hood, pipette 300 µl of the upper aqueous phase from each tube into the corresponding tube prepared in Step 5 (preferably 150 µl at a time with a 200 µl pipette, tip held at top of aqueous layer). Discard any mucus‑containing aspirate and restart from this step if needed. Dispose of PCA waste in a dedicated container.

steps.title: Vortex aqueous extract
steps.instruction: Briefly vortex the tubes containing the aqueous extract and return to ice.

steps.title: Pellet nucleic acids
steps.instruction: Spin tubes at maximum speed for 20 minutes at 4 °C to pellet genomic material.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Pour off the supernatant into liquid waste; the pellet should appear as white or red specks at the tube bottom.

steps.title: Add ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Add 100 µl 80 % ethanol to each tube and reseal tightly.

steps.title: Mix by inversion
steps.instruction: Manually invert tubes several times to mix; do not vortex to avoid breaking nucleic acids.

steps.title: Second centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at maximum speed for 5 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Discard ethanol
steps.instruction: Pour off ethanol supernatant, tapping or flicking gently to remove as much as possible; place tube upside down on a kimwipe.

steps.title: Dry pellet
steps.instruction: Air‑dry tubes for 15–30 minutes until no liquid droplets are visible.

steps.title: Additional drying
steps.instruction: Leave tubes upright, covered with a kimwipe, in a tube rack for an additional 10 minutes to ensure complete ethanol evaporation.

steps.title: Resuspend nucleic acids
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 30 µl molecular‑grade water and vortex for up to 10 seconds (vortexing may shear nucleic acids).

steps.title: DNA dilution for PCR (optional)
steps.instruction: If DNA will be used for PCR, dilute the eluate 100‑fold (e.g., 1 µl eluate + 99 µl molecular‑grade water) and proceed to PCR.

steps.title: Proceed to RNA cleanup (optional)
steps.instruction: If RNA is needed for sequencing or tag‑seq, continue with the RNA cleanup steps below.

steps.title: Dilute eluate for RNA binding
steps.instruction: Take 25 µl of the eluate from Step 21 and add 175 µl molecular‑grade water (final volume 200 µl); vortex briefly.

steps.title: Add RNA binding buffer
steps.instruction: Add 400 µl ZymoBiomics RNA binding buffer (two volumes) to the diluted sample and pipette up and down to mix.

steps.title: Add ethanol
steps.instruction: Add 600 µl 100 % ethanol (equal volume) and pipette up and down to mix.

steps.title: Load onto spin column (first half)
steps.instruction: Transfer half of the mixture to a Zymo‑Spin IC column in a collection tube; centrifuge as per kit instructions and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Load onto spin column (second half)
steps.instruction: Repeat the previous step with the remaining half so that all nucleic acid binds to the filter.

steps.title: In‑column DNase I treatment
steps.instruction: Perform the in‑column DNase I digestion according to the ZymoBiomics manual.

steps.title: RNA prep buffer wash
steps.instruction: Add 400 µl RNA Prep buffer to the column, centrifuge, and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: First ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Add 700 µl 80 % ethanol to the column, centrifuge, and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Second ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Add 400 µl 80 % ethanol to the column, centrifuge for 1 minute, and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Dry spin
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the column for 2 minutes to dry the filter; avoid splashing eluate onto the column when removing it from the collection tube.

steps.title: Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Transfer the spin column to a sterile 1.5 ml tube, add 20 µl molecular‑grade water to the column, incubate 5 minutes to dissolve RNA, then centrifuge to collect the eluate.
